name: What should I prepare before a contractor arrives for drywall patching?
description: Move nearby furniture away from the wall, clear a walking path, and locate any leftover paint cans so the technician can match your wall color and sheen.

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before a contractor arrives for drywall patching?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clear furniture, curtains, and wall art at least four to five feet away from the repair area to provide clear working space. Drywall sanding creates fine airborne dust, so having a clear pathway allows technicians to put down drop cloths and hang plastic barrier sheets if necessary. If you have leftover touch-up paint with the color formula label intact, set it out for review, as finding a match is much faster when the original sheen and paint base are already known.
